source.scope: All recipes in official Bedrock sample behavior_pack/recipes at this commit; not a claim to cover every Java-only or special hardcoded mechanic.

officialNpmVanillaData.finding: Contains item/block type ids only; no tag membership.

communityTags.use: candidate list for warnings/planning only; never used to mark a recipe available

classificationRules.block: id in mojang-items.json with raw_id < 256 (incl. negative) AND in mojang-blocks.json
classificationRules.item: id in mojang-items.json otherwise (sameNameBlock may exist; placement is not inferred)
classificationRules.unresolved: id in neither official registry (legacy alias / aux string); metadata kept in dataVariants
classificationRules.shape: official block property names first, then name pattern, else default_assumption (explicitly low confidence)
